_comment: Advisories the build is allowed to ship with, each with a reason and
a date the decision expires. An expired waiver fails the build exactly
like an unknown advisory: living with a known problem is a decision
somebody has to re-make, not one that gets inherited by whoever is on

advisories.because: Transitive through next. The advisory is XSS via unescaped </style> in the CSS stringifier, which needs attacker-controlled CSS reaching the build; all CSS here is authored in the repository and none is user supplied. The only fix is a major bump of next, which is not something to do inside a security patch.
advisories.review: Bump next deliberately, on its own, with the full suite and a deploy behind it.
